text:
sophie: quick follow-up from PM postmortem  need clear owners for rollout hardening (opt-outs, auto-rollback, blast-radius). keeping this short.
jamal: +1. can we make HOT (7d) and NEAR (21d)?
anya: HOT -> emergency opt-out flag + runtime fallback to safe-model-pool. i'll own. eta 2026-03-28.
mike: HOT -> auto-rollback controller + tests. conditions proposal: error_rate >=1.5% (3m) OR p95 >1.8s (2m). i'll PR by 2026-03-31.
lee: UX -> default blast-radius caps: 5% for 15m, scope by region & tier. i'll prototype modal + API. eta 2026-04-04.
sophie: add KV warmup gate for large-KV models: require prefix-cache-hit >=70% before ramp.
mike: sample policy stub:```yaml
canary: traffic:5% duration:15m gates:[error_rate,kv_warmup]
```
oncall-bot: Reminder: "Rollout safety weekly" Mon 10:00 starting 2026-03-30.
sophie: action list summary: 1) opt-out flag -> anya -> 2026-03-28; 2) auto-rollback & harness -> mike -> 2026-03-31; 3) console cap UX -> lee -> 2026-04-04. i'll update the postmortem and tracker. reply if anything missing. :white_check_mark:
